default_decision_guidance: Ignore expected, normal, or explained movement. Investigate when a material movement is contradictory, weakly corroborated, or requires a human explanation before action. Notify when the primary outcome is materially off course and connected evidence supports a non-urgent response. Escalate severe operational risk or an untrusted, stale, or unsafe source. Return insufficient_data when required evidence is missing, failed, stale, or not comparable.

growth-health.title: Growth health
growth-health.decision_guidance: The primary source is Growth command center. Treat Qualified pipeline as the corroborating source, Activation funnel and Growth platform incidents as diagnostic context, and Campaign and launch calendar as owner context. Ignore a movement when the primary and corroborating sources move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Qualified pipeline does not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when the primary outcome is materially off course and Qualified pipeline moves consistently, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when required evidence is unavailable, stale, or not comparable.
growth-health.what_to_watch: Whether acquisition is producing healthy, qualified growth rather than merely more traffic.
growth-health.why_watch: Leadership wants to know when growth performance needs coordinated action across marketing, product, and sales.
watch_for: The qualified acquisition outcome is moving materially relative to its normal baseline.
A related funnel, product, or campaign signal helps explain whether the movement matters.
Data freshness and comparability are sufficient for an operating decision.
questions: Is this a meaningful change in the growth outcome or an expected operating pattern?
Which connected signal best explains what the growth team should do next?

fulfillment-reliability.title: Fulfillment reliability
fulfillment-reliability.decision_guidance: The primary source is Delivery promise board. Treat Carrier service levels as the corroborating source, Warehouse capacity and Inventory availability as diagnostic context, and Fulfillment data pipeline as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Carrier service levels move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Carrier service levels do not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when delivery performance is materially off course and Carrier service levels support the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Fulfillment data pipeline cannot establish freshness or comparability.
fulfillment-reliability.what_to_watch: Whether customer delivery promises remain reliable across the order, warehouse, and carrier flow.
fulfillment-reliability.why_watch: Operations needs early warning when a delivery problem is broad enough to require intervention, not every isolated late package.
watch_for: The delivery promise is materially off course across more than one operational signal.
Warehouse, carrier, or inventory evidence identifies a plausible source of the movement.
The source data is complete enough to distinguish a real service problem from a reporting gap.
questions: Is the customer-facing delivery risk broad enough to act on now?
Is the strongest explanation in warehouse capacity, carrier performance, or inventory availability?

payment-trust.title: Payment trust
payment-trust.decision_guidance: The primary source is Payment trust overview. Treat Issuer declines as the corroborating source, Fraud pressure as diagnostic context, Payment incidents as owner context, and Payment controls as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Issuer declines move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Issuer declines do not corroborate it or Fraud pressure is mixed. Notify when payment performance is materially off course and Issuer declines support the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Payment controls cannot establish trustworthy comparable evidence.
payment-trust.what_to_watch: Whether customers can complete payment reliably without introducing fraud or compliance exposure.
payment-trust.why_watch: Risk and payments leaders need one view of revenue loss, issuer behavior, fraud pressure, and control health.
watch_for: Payment completion or loss is moving materially across a meaningful customer population.
Issuer, fraud, or control signals distinguish a recoverable payment issue from a risk event.
Authorization and data-quality evidence are trustworthy before action is taken.
questions: Should the payments team intervene, investigate, or leave the movement alone?
What connected evidence best explains the change without overstating causation?

customer-retention.title: Customer retention
customer-retention.decision_guidance: The primary source is Customer health board. Treat Product engagement and Renewal revenue as corroborating sources, Support friction as diagnostic context, and Account context as owner context. Ignore a movement when the primary and at least one corroborating source move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when the corroborating sources do not support it or Support friction is mixed. Notify when retention risk is materially off course and a corroborating source supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when the required evidence is unavailable, stale, or not comparable.
customer-retention.what_to_watch: Whether important customer relationships are becoming less healthy in a way that needs coordinated response.
customer-retention.why_watch: Executives care about durable retention risk, not normal account-level noise or a single delayed renewal.
watch_for: Retention risk is visible in both customer behavior and commercial signals.
Support, product usage, or account context helps distinguish a real relationship risk.
The account and revenue sources use comparable definitions and current data.
questions: Is the retention signal broad and important enough for leadership attention?
Which customer-facing signal should the account team investigate first?

product-adoption.title: Product adoption
product-adoption.decision_guidance: The primary source is Adoption review. Treat Experiment results as the corroborating source, Release timeline and User friction as diagnostic context, and Product event pipeline as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Experiment results move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Experiment results do not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when adoption is materially off course and Experiment results support the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Product event pipeline cannot establish freshness or comparability.
product-adoption.what_to_watch: Whether newly released product capabilities are reaching the intended users and creating healthy usage.
product-adoption.why_watch: Product leadership needs to separate real adoption problems from planned rollout effects, instrumentation gaps, and normal cohort variation.
watch_for: Adoption is materially different from the expected rollout path.
Usage, experiment, and release evidence agree on whether the movement is meaningful.
Instrumentation or data freshness problems are not being mistaken for product behavior.
questions: Is this an adoption problem, a rollout effect, or an instrumentation problem?
What should the product team inspect before changing the plan?

cloud-reliability.title: Cloud reliability
cloud-reliability.decision_guidance: The primary source is Platform health. Treat Incident timeline as the corroborating source, Recent deploys and Capacity pressure as diagnostic context, and Platform telemetry as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Incident timeline move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Incident timeline does not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when customer error rate is materially off course and Incident timeline supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Platform telemetry cannot establish freshness or comparability.
cloud-reliability.what_to_watch: Whether the platform can support customer workloads reliably and whether incidents need coordinated response.
cloud-reliability.why_watch: Platform leaders need signal across service health, deploys, incidents, and capacity instead of manually checking each system.
watch_for: Customer-impacting reliability is meaningfully worse than the operating baseline.
A deploy, incident, or capacity signal supports a plausible explanation.
The monitoring and incident data is fresh and complete enough to act.
questions: Is there a customer-impacting platform issue that needs escalation?
What operational evidence should the on-call team inspect first?

delivery-promise.title: Delivery promise
delivery-promise.decision_guidance: The primary source is Network service view. Treat Fleet capacity as the corroborating source, Weather context and Carrier exceptions as diagnostic context, and Dispatch completeness as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Fleet capacity move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Fleet capacity does not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when delivery promise is materially off course and Fleet capacity supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Dispatch completeness cannot establish fresh, comparable evidence.
delivery-promise.what_to_watch: Whether delivery performance is still aligned with the promise made to customers and with available fleet capacity.
delivery-promise.why_watch: The operations team should act on a system-level service risk, not chase normal variation in individual routes.
watch_for: Customer delivery performance and route capacity indicate a broad service risk.
Carrier, weather, or warehouse context explains or contradicts the movement.
The operational data is current and comparable across regions.
questions: Is the delivery promise at risk across the network or only in one pocket?
Which operational owner should investigate first?

fleet-cost.title: Fleet cost control
fleet-cost.decision_guidance: The primary source is Fleet cost analysis. Treat Fleet utilization as the corroborating source, Fuel surcharge as diagnostic context, Operating plan as owner context, and Service quality board as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Fleet utilization move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Fleet utilization does not corroborate it or Fuel surcharge is mixed. Notify when cost per delivery is materially off course and Fleet utilization supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Service quality board cannot establish trustworthy comparable evidence.
fleet-cost.what_to_watch: Whether transportation cost is drifting for reasons the business can act on without reducing service quality.
fleet-cost.why_watch: Finance and operations need to connect cost movement to fuel, utilization, route mix, and customer service rather than react to a single number.
watch_for: Cost is materially off plan and the movement is not explained by an expected route or fuel effect.
Utilization, fuel, or service evidence identifies a likely operational driver.
The cost and service views use the same period and population.
questions: Is the cost movement actionable without creating a service problem?
What connected operating signal should the team use to choose a response?

care-operations.decision_guidance: The primary source is Care access board. Treat Scheduling demand as the corroborating source, Staffing coverage as diagnostic context, Care incidents as owner context, and Care quality checks as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Scheduling demand move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Scheduling demand does not corroborate it or Staffing coverage is mixed. Notify when care access is materially off course and Scheduling demand supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Care quality checks cannot establish trustworthy comparable evidence.
care-operations.what_to_watch: Whether access to care is deteriorating in a way that needs operational intervention while quality remains protected.
care-operations.why_watch: Care leaders need a joined view of demand, wait time, staffing, quality, and incident context.
watch_for: Access or wait-time performance is materially worse across the relevant care population.
Staffing, demand, or quality evidence explains whether the movement requires action.
Patient and operational data are complete and trustworthy enough to discuss.
questions: Is this a real access problem or a data and scheduling artifact?
Which care-operations owner should respond first?

revenue-cycle.title: Revenue cycle
revenue-cycle.decision_guidance: The primary source is Revenue cycle view. Treat Claims throughput as the corroborating source, Denial reasons as diagnostic context, Cash plan as owner context, and Finance data freshness as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Claims throughput move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Claims throughput does not corroborate it or Denial reasons are mixed. Notify when net collections are materially off course and Claims throughput supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Finance data freshness cannot establish freshness or comparability.
revenue-cycle.what_to_watch: Whether revenue collection is on course and whether operational friction is creating avoidable financial risk.
revenue-cycle.why_watch: Finance leadership needs to connect cash movement to claims, denials, payment timing, and source trust.
watch_for: Cash or collection performance is materially off course relative to the operating plan.
Claims, denials, or payment timing provide a connected explanation.
The source definitions and data freshness support a responsible escalation.
questions: Is the financial movement actionable now or does it require investigation first?
Which operational evidence best explains the collection gap?

production-quality.title: Production quality
production-quality.decision_guidance: The primary source is Plant quality board. Treat Production lots as the corroborating source, Maintenance events as diagnostic context, Quality holds as owner context, and Inspection coverage as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Production lots move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Production lots do not corroborate it or Maintenance events are mixed. Notify when first-pass yield is materially off course and Production lots support the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Inspection coverage cannot establish trustworthy comparable evidence.
production-quality.what_to_watch: Whether production quality is drifting in a way that creates customer, safety, or cost consequences.
production-quality.why_watch: Plant and quality leaders need connected evidence across yield, defects, maintenance, and release holds.
watch_for: Quality performance is materially outside the normal operating range.
Maintenance, material, or process evidence supports a likely explanation.
Inspection coverage and source freshness are sufficient before escalation.
questions: Is this a plant-level quality issue or an isolated measurement problem?
What evidence should the quality owner investigate before changing production?

supply-continuity.title: Supply continuity
supply-continuity.decision_guidance: The primary source is Supply continuity view. Treat Supplier reliability as the corroborating source, Purchase orders and Demand plan as diagnostic context, and Inventory freshness as the trust source. Ignore a movement when the primary and Supplier reliability move together during a planned or expected operating pattern. Investigate a material primary movement when Supplier reliability does not corroborate it or the diagnostic evidence is mixed. Notify when critical supply coverage is materially off course and Supplier reliability supports the movement, unless severe operational risk requires escalation. Escalate when a severe connected operating condition is present. Return insufficient_data when Inventory freshness cannot establish freshness or comparability.
supply-continuity.what_to_watch: Whether critical supply inputs are at risk of disrupting production or customer commitments.
supply-continuity.why_watch: Supply leaders need to connect inventory, supplier performance, purchase orders, and demand changes before a shortage becomes an outage.
watch_for: Critical supply coverage is materially below the expected operating position.
Supplier, demand, or purchase-order evidence distinguishes a real risk from a planning artifact.
Inventory and supplier data are fresh and comparable.
questions: Is there a supply risk that needs intervention before the next planning cycle?
Which supplier or demand signal should the operating team investigate first?
